changes.title: VA benefit dollars by county first published
changes.summary: VA direct benefit expenditures in fiscal year 2025 for every county, state and the US, split into disability compensation and pension, survivor benefits, insurance and adapted housing: 187,660,338,257 dollars in all, with the year-earlier compensation and survivor dollars for comparison.
